title: Free Printable Baby Shower Invitations (Fill-in)
excerpt: Skip the paid-template maze. Download free fill-in baby shower invitations, add your details, and print as many as you need at home this week — no account, watermark, or shipping.
quick_answer: To make baby shower invitations with a printable, download a fill-in-the-blank template, add the honoree's name, date, time, address, RSVP, and registry, then print on cardstock at home. No account, watermark, or per-card fee — just fill in the blanks and print as many copies as you need.
seo_description: Free printable baby shower invitations to fill in and print at home. Add your details, pick cardstock, and mail this week — no sign-up or shipping wait.

faq_items.question: Are these baby shower invitations really free to print?
faq_items.answer: Yes. The fill-in template downloads free with no account, email, or watermark. You only pay for paper and ink. Print one test card, then run as many copies as your guest list needs on your home printer — there is no per-card fee or checkout.

faq_items.question: Can I type my details into the invitation or only handwrite them?
faq_items.answer: Both work. Open the PDF in a reader, type into the fields, and print a finished batch, or print the blank cards and write each detail in nice pen for a handmade feel. Handwriting adds a personal touch; typing is faster for a long guest list.

faq_items.question: How far in advance should I send baby shower invitations?
faq_items.answer: Send them four to six weeks before the shower. Use six weeks when guests travel or the family is large, four for a small local gathering. Set the RSVP deadline one to two weeks before so you have a firm headcount for food, seating, and favors.

faq_items.question: What size are the printable invitations and what envelopes fit?
faq_items.answer: The fill-in cards are sized to fold to a standard A2 or 4x6, so a box of matching A2 envelopes fits without trimming. Print at actual size on 80 to 110 lb cardstock, check the test card, then run the full batch in one pass.

faq_items.question: Can I use the same template for a couples' shower or other events?
faq_items.answer: Yes. The typography-only layout works for a couples' sprinkle, birthday, or any party — just swap the headline and details before printing. The blank fill-in lines adapt to any occasion, so one download covers the shower and future celebrations too.
